summary.english: Xiaomei and her brother go to a game, win, and enjoy bubble tea and noodles.
summary.chinese: 小美和她的哥哥去看球賽，他們贏了，然後喝珍奶、吃麵。
summary.pinyin: Xiǎoměi hé tā de gēge qù kàn qiúsài, tāmen yíng le, ránhòu hē zhēnǎi, chī miàn.

source.approvedEnglish:
The Big Win

Xiaomei and her brother An sat on the bus. They went to the stadium. Today was the big game.

"We want to win," said An.

"Yes, we want to win," said Xiaomei.

The game started. The two teams played hard. Xiaomei looked at the ball. An looked at the ball too. The ball went into the goal. Xiaomei's team got one point. The other team got one point.

At the end, the score was one to one. Then An saw a player. The player was fast. The player took the ball. He ran with the ball. The ball went into the goal again!

"We won! We won!" said Xiaomei.

"We won! We are very happy!" said An.

After the game, they went out of the stadium. A shop was near the stadium. The shop had bubble tea.

"I want bubble tea," said Xiaomei.

"I want bubble tea too," said An.

They went into the shop. They bought two cups of bubble tea. They drank the bubble tea. The tea was cold and sweet.

Then they were hungry. They went to the night market. The night market had many people. They walked and looked at the food.

"I want to eat noodles," said Xiaomei.

"I want to eat noodles too," said An.

They sat down. They ate noodles. The noodles were hot and good.

"We won the game today," said An.

"Yes! And we ate good food," said Xiaomei.

They went home. They were happy. They were tired. They sat on the sofa and drank more bubble tea.

"I like today," said Xiaomei.

"I like today too," said An. "We won. We ate. We drank. We are happy."
